'''Get Ayliah''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.

== Activities ==
He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]]. He goes of to track [[Faile Bashere]] when she is kidnapped by the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].

He catches up and questions a number of inhabitants who are fleeing [[Malden]] about the Shaido.
